PDE StudioWorkbench

Supported equations and methods

Periodic

1D/2D rectangular periodic domains. Fourier derivatives and ETDRK4; supported constant diagonal linear operators with an explicit remainder.

Second-order bounded

1D/2D rectangles. Constant nonnegative diagonal diffusion; Dirichlet, Neumann and passive Robin data. Robin coefficients satisfy α ≥ 0, β ≥ 0 and α + β > 0.

Fourth-order bounded

1D intervals. Negative constant leading fourth-order term per field and two admissible linear boundary rows at each end.

Numerical methods

One to three fields, computed with Float64 arithmetic in browser workers. Nonlinear terms are explicit; transport uses centered differences for smooth solutions. Check accuracy by refining the grid and time step.

Diagnostics

Three-level comparisons estimate convergence order. Balance and boundary residuals measure discrete consistency. Parameter scans compare solutions at specified times. Reference formulas provide pointwise comparisons.
